validity.recommendation: Revise StartYear1 (2021 unsupported; sources say awarded 2015, completed 2018) and re-check SegmentCost (GEM $820M vs lamar $536.05M); existence/route/length/diameter all confirmed.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED real and independently corroborated. This is the Aramco Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 2, Package 1, 'Western Region/Province Pipeline' — a 422 km, 56-inch underground gas trunk pipeline running from Pump Station 07 (near Riyadh) to Pump Station 11 (near Madina), built along Aramco's East-West Pipeline 2 corridor. Independent confirmation from DMS Projects (PRJ00021818: '422 kilometers of 56 inch pipeline on the East West Pipeline 2', owner Saudi Aramco), MEED (two separate articles both stating 422 km / 56-inch on East-West Pipeline 2, won by Al-Khobar firm KAD), and PRNewswire (Saudi KAD press release: contractor for Master Gas Program Phase II pipelines, biggest diameter 56-inch, completion target 2018). lamar-industrial (an EPC subcontractor's project page, the current GEM ref) gives the most granular detail: '422 km, 56-inch underground pipeline from Pump Station 07 near Riyadh to Pump Station 11 near Madina', 21 valve stations, awarded 2015 / completed 2018, value USD 536.05 million. CLASSIFICATION: Correctly recorded as gas transmission — this is a dry-gas trunk line on the Master Gas System (national gas grid), not gathering/NGL. Confirmed. DUPLICATE check vs roster: P7711 (Pump Station 06->Qassim, 226 km, dia 46) is the adjacent but distinct Package; P3962/P3966 'East-West Gas Pipeline (Saudi Arabia)' (Abqaiq->Yanbu) describe the original/earlier East-West line — P7712 runs on the *East-West Pipeline 2* corridor as a discrete MGSE-2 package (PS-07->PS-11), so it is NOT a duplicate of those, but reviewers should note the shared EW-2 corridor when reconciling geometry. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco (100%) confirmed across all sources; endpoints PS-07 (Riyadh province) -> PS-11 (Madina province) confirmed by lamar. ATTRIBUTION OK. SPEC: Length 422 km and diameter 56 in are HIGH confidence (>=2 independent: DMS + MEED + lamar all agree). CONCERNS — (1) DATES: GEM StartYear1=2021 is NOT supported by any independent source. Every source dates this to Phase II with award 2015 and target completion 2018 (lamar explicitly 'Completed in 2018'; KAD/MEED 'completed by end of 2018'). A 2021 in-service year looks wrong/unsupported — recommend revising to ~2018 or flagging. (2) COST: GEM SegmentCost=$820,000,000 vs lamar's stated project value USD 536.05 million — a material disagreement; the current metenders ref did not contain the 820M figure on re-check. The ~$827m / $1bn figures in MEED refer to the bundle of multiple packages KAD won, not this single 422 km package, so the $820M may be a mis-attributed bundle cost. Recommend re-verifying SegmentCost (likely the $536M package value is the correct single-segment figure).

summary: P7712 (MGSE Phase 2 Pkg 1 Western Region, PS-07->PS-11, 422km x 56in) is real, correctly classified gas transmission, owner Aramco; existence/route/length/diameter HIGH-confidence corroborated; CONCERN on StartYear1=2021 (sources say completed 2018) and SegmentCost $820M (lamar says $536M).
